Study format
Self-paced; confirm the course access period and required assignments before purchase.
Pricing
Per-course purchases. Current catalog prices vary; books and proctor arrangements can add expense. No universal per-course price is assumed.
Assessments
Syllabus-specific assignments and proctored exams; official guidance describes SmarterServices and approved alternative proctors.
Credit type
NCCRS recommendations for designated learning; receiving institutions award the actual credits.
